text:
incident-bot: OBSERVABILITY INGESTION WARNING - delayed logs/metrics inbound and elevated forwarder retries detected for region us-east-2. Severity: P2. Auto-page: @ash. Suggested runbook: obs-dep-fallback-v3.

ash: Oncall here. Acknowledge. Quick snapshot pls: scope, any active customer pages?

mei: seeing backlog markers in our forwarders starting ~2028-03-22T11:58:00Z. Egress logs: consistent `429 Too Many Requests` and occasional `503`. Affected tenants span multiple accounts, several enterprise.

carlos: customers report missing SLO windows and blank log views. Our synthetic checks for dashboards returned 504/empty. Traces still somewhat ok.

opsbot: RUNBOOK STEP 1: validate agent/forwarder health.

mei: agents healthy. Forwarder excerpt: ```
2028-03-22T11:59:05Z WARN forwarder http->api.datadoghq.com status=429 retry-after=20s
2028-03-22T12:00:12Z WARN forwarder write buffer=high backpressure=1.23
```
No crash loops. Upstream throttling confirmed.

ash: ok that matches. Plan: (1) flip critical alert evaluation to our local Prom eval (prom-fallback); (2) bring up internal Influx bridge to serve dashboards for immediate read-only views; (3) start prioritized S3 buffering and enable replay-accelerator for flagged enterprise tenants; (4) post brief comms to support & status. Mei + Carlos execute 1/3. Tara do comms.

mei: applying prom-fallback now. Command: ```bash
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f /ops/fallbacks/prom-primary.yaml
```
Silencing duplicates as they fire.

carlos: spinning up influx bridge to provide a read-only copy of critical infra metrics: ```bash
./ops/influx-bridge --src=prom://local --dest=influx://rw-obs-bridge --filter=env:prod --window=15m &
```
This will give product teams a read-only slice for triage.

opsbot: CHECKPOINT - prom-fallback enabled, influx bridge started. Proceed to buffering step.

carlos: starting prioritized S3 buffer for enterprise tenants: ```bash
./tools/buffer --out s3://rw-priority-buffers/2205678901/ --priority-file=/ops/priority-tenants.txt --region us-east-2 &
```
Replay-accelerator configured to tag tenant objects and mark expedited replays. Retention=10d.

ash: good. Tara, can you draft a short support/status blurb and add guidance for support agents? Need to include expected ETA and mention priority replay option.

tara: draft: "We are investigating delayed ingest to Datadog in us-east-2 which may cause missing or delayed dashboards and alerts. Engineers have enabled internal fallbacks (Prometheus + Influx bridge), are buffering logs/metrics, and prioritized enterprise tenants for expedited replay. Datadog case opened. ETA pending their update (we expect updates within 30-60 minutes)." Add link to support case after Datadog responds.

datadog-support: Hi Redwood team, Datadog engineer here. We're actively investigating ingestion throttling in us-east-2 related to a capacity mismatch in our intake cluster. We're applying mitigations and expect initial recovery within ~30-45m. Case DD-701920 opened. We'll post updates.

ash: thanks. While we wait: (A) flip PagerDuty hooks to direct PD for fallback rules; (B) mute non-actionable alerts to reduce noise; (C) make sure buffer objects are per-tenant and ordered. Mei handle A/B, Carlos ensure ordering.

mei: flipping PD hooks to direct now and muting noisy alerts. Command: ```bash
alertctl route --mode=direct-pd --selector critical=true
alertctl mute --match "severity:low" --duration 45m
```

carlos: confirming buffer uses sequence numbers and per-tenant prefixes. Replay-accelerator will honor original timestamps and be idempotent. Added metadata `replay-priority=true` for tenants in the priority list.

opsbot: ACTION LOG: prom eval, influx bridge, prioritized buffer started, PD direct, noisy alerts muted.

ash: also create per-tenant redirect for any customers with direct write endpoints. We should preserve ordering and add a small manifest for each tenant with object checksums. Carlos, can you do a lambda redirect for those tenants?

carlos: done. Lambda now copies incoming payloads into the priority S3 prefix and returns 202 to clients. Added manifest.json to each prefix for replay auditing.

tara: support KB updated with canned replies and the priority replay request form for account teams. Posting internal status now.

datadog-support: Update: mitigation in progress; intake capacity being increased and backlog is being processed. ETA update ~25-35 minutes. We'll prioritize customers flagged for expedited replay.

ash: good. I'll set a handoff for 14:30 UTC if this continues. Please track buffer sizes and PD alerts. Also add an item to the postmortem: automate priority replays and add an observability provider throttling test to chaos.

mei: buffer growth steady at ~200MB/min. Keeping replay-accelerator in standby. We've added `Retry-After` parsing to our buffer metrics so replay can pace automatically.

carlos: kicked off a small verification replay for one priority tenant once Datadog gave the go-ahead. Observed minor parser mismatch for one custom log format; transformed and requeued. Logging details in incident doc.

opsbot: REMINDER: escalate to dedicated incident channel if > 8 enterprises affected or duration > 60m.

datadog-support: Update: throughput recovering; backlog draining. We'll remain in the case for monitoring and will prioritize replays on request. Apologies for disruption.

ash: thanks. Handing off to Carlos in 20m if still active. Carlos, watch the replay-accelerator and Datadog case. Tara keep support updated.

carlos: will take over. Monitoring replay queue and verifying dashboard repopulation. I'll close mitigation steps gradually once backlog drains.

tara: sent customer comms to affected account teams and posted internal status. Support queue stable.

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied and monitoring. If any customer escalations arise, escalate to #eng-oncall.

carlos: dashboards are repopulating for most tenants. Replay-accelerator running at conservative throughput to avoid re-triggering throttles. Will keep artifacts in incident doc for postmortem.

datadog-support: Final update: ingestion restored to normal capacity, backlog processing. We'll reach out to affected customers directly for confirmation if they requested expedited replays. Case remains open briefly for monitoring.

ash: thanks team. Handoff to Carlos now. Opening postmortem draft to capture actions and follow-ups.

carlos: ack. Taking point and locking thread to operations-only.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations active and backlog processing. Reopen thread if new issues arise."
